name: LeBron James
summary: James is one of the most politically outspoken athletes of his generation, focusing mainly on racial justice, police killings of Black Americans and voting access, including co-founding the voting-rights group More Than a Vote in 2020. He has endorsed Democratic presidential candidates from Obama through Harris and has been a frequent critic of Donald Trump. He has said little about economic, foreign-policy or most other policy questions.

abortion-legal.rationale: When Roe v. Wade was overturned in June 2022 he posted "It's ABSOLUTELY ABOUT POWER & CONTROL!!", amplifying an activist critical of the ruling. This signals opposition to the decision, but he has not directly stated a view on when abortion should be legal, so confidence is low.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: He has repeatedly spoken about racism against Black Americans (in 2017 saying society has "a long way to go" before African Americans "feel equal in America"), co-founded More Than a Vote in 2020 to fight voter suppression in Black communities, and joined the 2020 playoff boycott over the police shooting of Jacob Blake. This shows support for actively addressing racial injustice; he has not stated a position on specific remedies such as reparations, so not scored +2.

notes: Most of his political expression is partisan endorsement and reaction to specific events (police shootings, Trump remarks) rather than policy positions, so endorsements were not converted into answers. His 2019 remark that Daryl Morey was "misinformed" about Hong Kong and his 2023 Instagram post supporting Israel do not map cleanly onto any statement and were not scored.
